stories.title: Token Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define MongoDB token schema including fields for token hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, rotation_parent_id, and scope. Document validation rules and hashing requirements.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No formal token lifecycle schema currently defined

stories.title: Token Rotation Service Logic
stories.description: Implement backend service to rotate active tokens by issuing a new token, linking to prior token, and invalidating the old token based on policy.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Rotation logic not present in current bearer token validation

stories.title: Token Revocation API Endpoint
stories.description: Expose secure API endpoint to revoke tokens manually (admin/system use), updating revocation state and enforcing immediate invalidation in validation flow.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/function_app.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No revocation endpoint exists for GPTReader tokens

stories.title: End-to-End Token Validation Integration
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle-aware token validation into GPTReader request flow, enforcing expiration, revocation, and rotation chain checks during each request.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests covering token issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, TTL expiry behavior, and validation edge cases.
